With daily shipments of fuel entering from China to power these unauthorized operations, local communities are taking a stand, loudly protesting the ruthless exploitation of state wealth by KIA insurgents and its network.

Fighting continues across multiple fronts, including Kachin State where resistance forces have attacked junta resupply flotillas on the Irrawaddy River, destroying or damaging vessels bound for embattled Bhamo. Suicide drones struck regime warplanes at Mandalay's Tada-U Airbase. The Arakan Army controls most of Rakhine State.
